baseline.before_implementation: ProjectionProbe:2tests fail in0.183s. The valid20,000mm2 face becomes closed outer4edges/open inner3edges/open inner1edge through raw HLR+wire reconstruction. Native covering and union stay valid under0o1, but HorizontalArea is0 rather than the positive footprint.
baseline.input: Unchanged3.4KB native face fixture from FreeCAD-0o1. No building document opened or edited.
baseline.raw_linework_control: TechDraw.project is HLR drawing-linework, not a complete-face topology projection. The unchanged raw API still produces3wires; this is retained as a control, not claimed repaired or required to preserve holes.
baseline.area_integration_discovery: The first exact affine geometry candidate passes validity/closed-hole checks but legacy nonadaptive Area gives279.9065056136522mm2 for a tilted rectangular face with circular holes, versus analytic279.5796477516664. This candidate was not accepted by loosening test tolerances.
baseline.adaptive_api_red: Four new Part methods produced11 missing-method AttributeErrors before native API implementation; evidence /private/tmp/freecad-8y1-area-audit.WG4E0O/adaptive-area-red.log.
baseline.vertical_edit_red: Native horizontal-to-vertical component edit retained HorizontalArea200 instead of0. Reproduced by a new native regression before the targeted footprint reset.

cause: BIM reconstructed planar topology from HLR linework, losing shared vertices and holes in a toleranced input. Complete-face affine projection retains correct geometry, but its rational splines also expose an independent default nonadaptive surface-integration inaccuracy. Neither arbitrary edge-joining tolerances nor acceptance of the inaccurate area is appropriate.

fix.planar_projection: Copy the full face with no element map. Translate horizontal faces rigidly toXY. For other planar faces use a determinant1 shear that leavesX/Y unchanged and maps the located supporting plane toZ0. Derive the located normal/point through normalAt/valueAt at UV midpoint; preserve wire/hole topology without edge reconstruction. Reject invalid projected geometry and leave sourceBRep, maps, placement and tolerances unchanged.
fix.adaptive_surface_api: New opt-in TopoShape.getSurfaceArea(relativeTolerance=1e-9,positional-only) wraps native adaptive BRepGProp.SurfaceProperties. Validate finite0<tolerance<=0.001, finite/nonnegative estimated relative error within the request and finite area. Null/invalid tolerance raisesValueError; native failure/nonconvergence raisesOCCError. Legacy Area behavior is unchanged. This is integration tolerance, never geometry/healing tolerance.
fix.BIM_quantities: Measure the transient projected union with the adaptive native API. Use existing adaptive native Curve.length on trimmed outer-wire edges for perimeter, retaining the outer-only single-outline convention. Preserve0o1 known-error diagnostics/reset and exact temporary preference restoration.
fix.vertical_edit: Clear obsolete horizontal area/perimeter when a component has only vertical faces, retaining its computed vertical area. Exactly vertical helper inputs produce no footprint; small nonzero slopes are not arbitrarily discarded by the helper. Existing BIM face-classification thresholds are unchanged.

verification.expected_failure: Existing BIM tilted-beam cross-section Y-axis test, not weakened or introduced here.
verification.projection_cases: Original toleranced ring; placed/sloping rectangular face with two circular holes; reversed orientation; placed planar NURBS; vertical and near-vertical helper cases; coincident/stacked, overlapping and disjoint projected union areas; intentional filling of only one hole; original sourceBRep/maps/placement/tolerances unchanged; cleared analysis maps; nonplanar input rejected by planar helper; circular outer-outline native area/perimeter.
verification.native_failure_containment: Actual native recompute with injected known projection failure leaves material and downstream union valid, resets quantities and emits an actionable warning. Save/reopen preserves that failure state; removing the fault and ordinary recompute restores positive quantities with identical material/union volumes. Direct known/unexpected error and preference restoration cases remain covered.
verification.persistence: Independent GUI process checks saved positive quantities, owner states and shapes before target recompute, then repeats ordinary recomputes. FCStd includesGuiDocument.xml; rendered native union inspected. No quantity reassignment or material-shape replacement is used to repair results.
verification.numerical_budgets: Direct analytic planar projection uses absolute1e-7mm2 checks; adaptive native integration convergence checked at relative1e-7/1e-9/1e-11. The inherited native extrusion differs from its pristine profile by9.94e-5mm2 in volume/height; a separate fixture-only1e-3mm2 assertion budget is documented and never passed to any geometry API. Material geometry and volume remain unchanged.
verification.lint_format: New/changed BIM Python tests and GUI probe pass flake8 --ignore=E266,W503 --max-line-length=100. Normalized legacy ArchComponent26 findings and Part TopoShapeTest9 findings match baseline. Changed C++ lines pass git-clang-format. CRLF-aware git diff --check passes.
verification.independent_review: API/source responsibilities and numerical accuracy independently audited. Independent final review found a native0o1 containment-coverage gap; added and verified native failure/save/reopen/recovery test. Re-review reports no remaining concrete findings. A source-only findPlane location suspicion was checked natively and not reproduced, so no defect was asserted from it.

installation: No installation command or application replacement performed. The source build still uses the repository Pixi dependency environment.
